_original_lore: The Minos Inquisitor is the rarest mob in the
Mythological Ritual, and can only be found
using a legendary Griffin Pet. It reduces
your stats by 10% every time you hit it,
maxing out at a 40% reduction. Similar to the
Minos Champion, its stats increase by 6% for every
second it is alive, capping at 600%, which is
when it despawns. While alive, it summons
lightning on the block you are standing on.
name: 弥诺斯审判官 (神话生物)

loreParagraphs.translation: 弥诺斯审判官是神话仪式中最稀有的怪物,只能使用传说狮鹫宠物找到.你每次击中它,它都会降低你的属性 {{N0}},最多降低 {{N1}}.与弥诺斯勇士类似,它的属性每存活一秒就增加 {{N2}},上限为 {{N3}},达到上限时它就会消失.存活期间,它会在你站立的方块上召唤闪电.
怪物类型: ✿ 神话, ✰ 人形, ♣ 难以捉摸
